title: fix(xbeam): explain cuFile failures on tmpfs inputs

files.patch:
@@ -105,6 +105,23 @@ logging for timings. See [hardware eligibility](components/xdr.md#hardware-eligi
 for buffer and tile-size requirements. FITS receipts retain requested choices,
 including choices that did not apply when the selected reader was Astropy.
 
+## cuFile input on tmpfs fails to register
+
+cuFile (GPUDirect Storage) needs files on a disk-backed filesystem. If the
+input is on `tmpfs` or `ramfs`, such as `/tmp` on many systems, opening or
+reading it can fail with `HANDLE_NOT_REGISTERED`, or opening it with
+`O_DIRECT` can fail with `Invalid argument` (`ramfs`, and `tmpfs` before
+Linux 6.6, do not support `O_DIRECT`). Check the filesystem of the temporary
+directory and of the input file:
+
+```bash
+findmnt -T "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" -o TARGET,FSTYPE
+findmnt -T <input path> -o TARGET,FSTYPE
+```
+
+If either reports `tmpfs` or `ramfs`, point `TMPDIR` (or the input path) at
+local disk storage and rerun.
+
 ## A command rejected the input
 
 Use the component inspection or validation command before the expensive step.

@@ -22,6 +23,53 @@ class CuFileUnavailable(RuntimeError):
     """The requested cuFile data path cannot be initialized."""
 
 
+_RAM_FILESYSTEMS = frozenset({"tmpfs", "ramfs"})
+# The kernel escapes space, tab, newline and backslash in mountinfo as \ooo.
+_MOUNTINFO_ESCAPE = re.compile(r"\\([0-7]{3})")
+
+
+def _filesystem_type(
+    path: str | os.PathLike[str],
+    mountinfo: str | os.PathLike[str] = "/proc/self/mountinfo",
+) -> str | None:
+    """Return the filesystem type mounted at path, or None if unknown."""
+    try:
+        target = os.path.realpath(path)
+        best_mount = ""
+        best_type = None
+        with open(mountinfo, encoding="utf-8") as lines:
+            for line in lines:
+                head, separator, tail = line.partition(" - ")
+                # mountinfo separates fields with ASCII spaces; other
+                # Unicode whitespace can be part of a mount-point name.
+                fields = head.split(" ")
+                if not separator or len(fields) < 5 or not tail.split():
+                    continue
+                mount = _MOUNTINFO_ESCAPE.sub(
+                    lambda match: chr(int(match[1], 8)), fields[4]
+                )
+                inside = target == mount or target.startswith(
+                    mount.rstrip("/") + "/"
+                )
+                if inside and len(mount) >= len(best_mount):
+                    best_mount, best_type = mount, tail.split()[0]
+        return best_type
+    except (OSError, UnicodeError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _ram_filesystem_hint(path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> str:
+    """Explain a cuFile failure when the file lives in RAM-backed storage."""
+    kind = _filesystem_type(path)
+    if kind not in _RAM_FILESYSTEMS:
+        return ""
+    return (
+        f"; {path} is on {kind}, which cuFile does not support. Use a "
+        "disk-backed filesystem, for example by pointing TMPDIR (or the "
+        "input path) at local disk storage"
+    )
+
+
 _DRIVER_LOCK = Lock()
 _DRIVER_USERS = 0
